description: Science, religion and politics compete for authority when SETI researcher Ellie Arroway (Jodie Foster) discovers a radio transmission of extraterrestrial origin. description: The year is 1844, and the hardships facing a small Swedish community seem unending. Desiring an escape from famine, poverty, and rigid social constraints, a group of families decides to seek a better life in America. Starring Max von Sydow and Liv Ullmann, THE EMIGRANTS offers a hopeful portrait of migration. Intimately focused on the lives of its central characters, the film draws attention to the details of daily life within a larger narrative.
tldr: Famine, poverty and persecution drive a group of mid-19th century Swedish farmers to seek their future in the distant land of Minnesota.

description: The Tenenbaum family is brilliant—and completely dysfunctional. description: David Cronenberg's 1986 remake of THE FLY is probably his most accessible entry into the realm of body horror. Eccentric scientist Seth Brundle (Jeff Goldblum) believes his groundbreaking teleportation device is ready for human testing—and impulsively decides to become his own test subject. What follows is a transformation that is grotesque, darkly funny, and unexpectedly sympathetic. You won't be able to look away, even though you may want to.
tldr: While trying to prove the safety of his groundbreaking invention, a scientist undergoes a horrific metamorphosis. Bzzz... bzzz...

description: Wim Wenders' PERFECT DAYS was Japan's 2023 submission for Best International Feature at the Academy Awards  —the first ever film by a non-Japanese director to be given this honor. PERFECT DAYS observes the life of a Tokyo toilet cleaner (Kōji Yakusho; Shall We Dance?, Cure) over the course of one week. We watch as the small dramas of daily life unfold against a spectacular soundtrack of 60s and 70s music. The film challenges traditional notions of success, and pushes its audience to reflect on what makes a good life. Wenders has long been an admirer of the director Yasujirō Ozu (check out TOKYO-GA, 1985), and his influence has never shown more clearly than in this film.
tldr: A Tokyo toilet cleaner finds beauty and meaning in daily routines.

description: Satyajit Ray's PATHER PANCHALI (1955) follows the lives of Apu and Durga, siblings growing up in rural Bengal in the early 20th century. Shot on location with mostly nonprofessional actors, the film features gorgeous cinematography by Subrata Mitra who, amazingly, had never before used a movie camera. Through Apu's eyes, we experience the rhythms of family life set to a beautiful score by Ravi Shankar.
tldr: In early 20th century India, the lives of two young siblings unfold to a beautiful score by Ravi Shankar.

description: MY DINNER WITH ANDRE (1981), directed by Louis Malle, consists almost entirely of a dinner conversation between two old friends at an upscale Manhattan restaurant. Written by and starring Wallace Shawn and Andre Gregory—who use their real names—the film explores diverse topics from experimental theater to the challenges of relationships. What begins as a casual catch-up turns into a profound discussion of life and art.
tldr: A struggling playwright is cornered into having dinner with an old friend, leading to an unexpectedly profound conversation.

description: George Bailey (Jimmy Stewart) has always put others ahead of himself. However, no good deed goes unpunished, and on Christmas Eve he finds himself facing financial ruin. description: In the outskirts of Tokyo, a poor but close-knit group living on the fringes of society survives through shoplifting and odd jobs.
